review_output: {"summary":"I found 1 BLOCKER, 2 MAJOR, 4 MINOR and 1 NIT. The audit is still diagnostic only: coverage is always unknown and there is no proof writer. Its tenant scoping, read-only repeatable-read check, source-first enumeration and revision capture look correct. The new trigger bumps a hot counter row on every verified source write. That conflicts with the payment gate that is still failing, and it can deadlock against the capture guard. The audit's join set can also change without a revision bump.","findings":[{"severity":"BLOCKER","file":"prisma/migrations/20261015170000_live_metric_registration_source_revision/migration.sql","area":"Concurrency/Serializable payment path","issue":"Every verified FormSubmission insert, update or delete runs UPDATE on the LiveMetricVersion rows for that live. This puts a hot, exclusively locked counter row inside payment transactions. It also cascades into the existing invalidation of reports and certificates.","evidence":"FOR version_id ... UPDATE \"LiveMetricVersion\" SET \"sourceRevision\"=\"sourceRevision\"+1. The 20/20 concurrency PASS is ReadCommitted only. The original Serializable payment 20/20 gate FAILS and is not waived.","impact":"Concurrent verifications on the same live serialize on one row. Under Serializable they get 40001 'could not serialize access due to concurrent update', so paid registrations can roll back. Each payment transaction also does invalidation writes.","recommended_fix":"Keep the counter UPDATE out of payment transactions. Option 1: write to an append-only per-live source-change log (insert only, bigserial) and read the max id inside the audit snapshot. Option 2: make payment acceptance retry 40001 with bounded retries and idempotent effects. Re-run the original gate unchanged.","required_test":"Original synchronized Serializable payment 20/20 gate on one live with all triggers enabled. Require 20 commits, no 40001 or 40P01, and revision delta equal to 20 or log rows equal to 20.","confidence":0.85},{"severity":"MAJOR","file":"prisma/migrations/20261015170000_live_metric_registration_source_revision/migration.sql","area":"Deadlock/lock order","issue":"The capture guard and the new trigger lock the same two rows in opposite order. The capture guard locks the LiveMetricVersion row (FOR SHARE) and then the FormSubmission row (FOR SHARE). The new trigger runs after the FormSubmission row is already locked by the write, then UPDATEs the version row. A share-to-exclusive lock upgrade on the version row can also happen within one transaction.","evidence":"wp20_metric_capture_guard runs PERFORM ... LiveMetricVersion FOR SHARE, then FormSubmission FOR SHARE OF s. The new trigger is AFTER UPDATE ON FormSubmission and then UPDATEs LiveMetricVersion.","impact":"Tx A verifies submission S (row lock on S), then its trigger waits on version V. Tx B inserts a capture for S, holds a share lock on V, and waits on S. This is a 40P01 deadlock, and the victim may be the payment or verification transaction. Two transactions that each hold a share lock on V and then bump V also deadlock.","recommended_fix":"Use one lock order everywhere: lock the version row first in the verification path (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE of the versions in id order before updating the submission), or take FOR NO KEY UPDATE in the guard. Better still, remove the version-row write as in the BLOCKER fix.","required_test":"Use real connections and barriers. Run capture insert against UNVERIFIED-to-VERIFIED update of the same submission, and capture plus verify in one transaction against another such transaction. Require no 40P01.","confidence":0.75},{"severity":"MAJOR","file":"src/lib/live-metric-registration-audit.ts","area":"Source membership and revision fencing","issue":"Which rows the audit includes depends on Live.formId, Live.vendorId and RegistrationForm.vendorId. The trigger only fires on FormSubmission, so changes to those columns do not bump sourceRevision. Verified submissions from a live's earlier form are also silently excluded, not reported.","evidence":"JOIN \"Live\" l ... AND l.\"formId\"=s.\"formId\" and JOIN RegistrationForm f ... vendorId. The trigger is attached only to FormSubmission.","impact":"The same sourceRevision can produce different row sets or digests. Authoritative verified sources can disappear from the audit, which defeats the source-first goal and weakens any future certificate fencing.","recommended_fix":"Enumerate by s.liveId and the Live's vendor. Report a form mismatch as its own outcome instead of filtering those rows out. Alternatively, add revision triggers on changes to Live.formId/vendorId and RegistrationForm.vendorId.","required_test":"Change Live.formId after verified submissions exist. Assert the rows are still enumerated (as form_mismatch) or that the revision increases.","confidence":0.7},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/lib/live-metric-registration-audit.ts","area":"Audit completeness","issue":"Enumeration starts only from verified sources. Registrations without a valid verified source in the window, such as orphaned, unverified or other-window rows, are never reported. A registration that exists without a capture is reported as missing_capture, which hides the registration.","evidence":"FROM FormSubmission ... LEFT JOIN LiveMetricRegistration g. In the outcome order, captureVersionId===null is checked before registrationId.","impact":"Not a problem while coverage is unknown. A future certificate built on this audit could miss inflated registration counts.","recommended_fix":"Add a reverse pass over LiveMetricRegistration in the same snapshot for registrations with no valid source. Add a separate registration_without_capture outcome.","required_test":"Fixture with an orphan registration, and one with a registration but no capture. Assert distinct outcomes.","confidence":0.7},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"prisma/migrations/20261015170000_live_metric_registration_source_revision/migration.sql","area":"Revision fencing","issue":"TRUNCATE on FormSubmission does not fire row triggers. Verified sources that have no capture can be removed without a revision bump. When captures exist, the no-truncate trigger on the capture table blocks the cascade, but only then.","evidence":"Only AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ... FOR EACH ROW.","impact":"Sources can vanish without the revision changing.","recommended_fix":"Add a BEFORE TRUNCATE statement trigger on FormSubmission that rejects the truncate or bumps every version.","required_test":"TRUNCATE FormSubmission with verified sources and no captures. Expect rejection or a revision increase.","confidence":0.6},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"scripts/wp20-registration-source-concurrency.mjs","area":"Test coverage","issue":"The test covers only ReadCommitted direct VERIFIED inserts. It skips the real UNVERIFIED-to-VERIFIED update, changes to liveId or verifiedAt, deletes, capture racing verification, and Serializable.","evidence":"create() inserts with verificationStatus 'VERIFIED'. The script's scope string itself says it is not Serializable.","impact":"The PASS does not cover the paths most exposed to the BLOCKER and deadlock findings.","recommended_fix":"Add an update and delete revision matrix and the concurrent cases from the BLOCKER and deadlock findings. Assert revision deltas per old and new live.","required_test":"Revision delta assertions for: verify, unverify, move liveId (both lives bumped), change verifiedAt, delete, and a no-op update (no bump).","confidence":0.8},{"severity":"MINOR","file":"src/lib/live-metric-registration-source-audit.ts","area":"Timeouts","issue":"The 25s wall-clock check runs only before each page. A page that starts at about 24.9s can run for the 5s statement timeout and then hit the 30s Prisma transaction timeout, which throws P2028 instead of returning limit_exceeded. A 1M-row audit (about 2000 pages at about 150ms each) can never finish within the limits.","evidence":"if (performance.now()-started>=25000) ...; timeout:30000; statement_timeout 5000; the full 50k-row audit takes 14.8s.","impact":"Long audits fail with a transaction error instead of a clean unavailable result. The 1M-row limit is unreachable in practice.","recommended_fix":"Leave room for one statement (stop at 30s minus 5s minus a margin) and/or catch P2028 and return limit_exceeded. Lower the default row limit, or confirm an index on (liveId, verificationStatus, id).","required_test":"Inject a slow page near the deadline. Expect status unavailable/limit_exceeded and no thrown error.","confidence":0.6},{"severity":"NIT","file":"src/lib/live-metric-registration-source-audit.ts","area":"Digest determinism","issue":"The digest hashes JSON.stringify({...scope}). The result depends on the caller's property order.","evidence":"JSON.stringify({ format, ...scope })","impact":"The same observation can produce different digests.","recommended_fix":"Serialize scope fields in a fixed, explicit order.","required_test":"Same scope with different key order gives the same digest.","confidence":0.7}]}
